response.query: How will selected Asian reference sites be chosen and used to calibrate, validate, and test sensitivity of dispersal and demographic model priors and outputs?
response.answer: Selected Asian reference sites will be chosen based on demographic and environmental criteria, then used to calibrate, validate, and test the sensitivity of dispersal and demographic model priors and outputs.
